snippet.title: Tiny Capsule Collector - Deep Dive | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Turn the bottom of your desktop into a tiny Tokyo-inspired world with Tiny Capsule Collector, a cozy idle game designed to keep you company while you work, study or unwind.

Build and manage your own miniature Gachapon shop as adorable animal customers visit your storefront and try their luck at your capsule machines. Unlock new capsule toys, complete your collector's journal and display your growing collection of trinkets directly on your desktop.

Designed for low-focus play, Tiny Capsule Collector progresses in real time without fail states or demanding your constant attention. And with Twitch integration, viewers can even appear as customers inside your shop during streams.

Wishlist Tiny Capsule Collector now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4438600/Tiny_Capsule_Collector/

Coming to PC in September 2026.
